title: Respan
brief: LLM observability and tracing platform (tracing, prompts, evals, gateway) — the company site behind the RespanAI announcement tweet.
details: Respan is an AI router with built-in observability and automated evaluations, built by Keywords AI, Inc. (a YC company). You point the SDK you already use at one endpoint to reach 1,000+ models across providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Groq, Fireworks, Together AI, Perplexity, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex and Gemini, and more — with automatic fallbacks, response caching, and spend limits, so one provider's outage never takes your app down. On top of routing it traces, monitors, red-teams, and evaluates every agent run, with dashboards for workflows, monitors, traces, evaluations, and deployments. It integrates with the Python and JS/TS SDKs, OpenAI SDK and Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google GenAI, Mem0, Cognee, AssemblyAI, Linkup, and PostHog. Security posture includes SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and a trust center. Sign up for an API key or book a demo.
